cards.name: Ancestor Prophecy Trigger
cards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
cards.effect: When an ally benefits from one of your Oracle features and then lands a critical hit before the end of its next turn, regain 1 RC, never above your maximum. One critical event restores at most 1 RC and copied attacks or staged targets do not qualify.

originalObjects.value: When you aid an ally who lands a critical hit, regain 1 Revelation Charge

cards.name: Ancestral Guardian
cards.effect: A spectral guardian accompanies you. Gain +1 AC against the first attack targeting you each round and +1 on saves against charm, fear and other mind-affecting control. Once per long rest when an ally within 3 tiles is targeted by a single-target attack, use your Reaction before the roll; the guardian becomes the target instead and the attack automatically hits the guardian harmlessly, then the guardian vanishes until your next long rest. The interception cannot stop area effects.

value.name: Ancestral Guardian
value.description: Passive: spectral guardian grants +1 AC vs first attack each round and +5% resistance to mind-affecting effects. Once per long rest, intercept a single-target attack against an ally within 3 tiles (guardian takes the hit and vanishes until long rest).

cards.name: Echo Voice
cards.rangeAndTarget: One willing ally within 5 tiles; telepathy with willing allies within 5 tiles
cards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one reroll per failed roll
cards.effect: You may communicate telepathically with willing allies within 5 tiles. When one such ally fails an attack roll, saving throw or ability check, use your Reaction and spend 1 RC before another roll is made. That ally rerolls the failed roll with +2 and must use the new result. The reroll cannot itself trigger another Echo Voice.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Ancestor; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Echo Voice
value.description: Passive: telepathy with allies within 5 tiles. Active: spend 1 charge to let an ally repeat their last failed roll (attack, save, or skill) with +2.

cards.name: Ancestral Strike
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; next weapon or touch attack before end of turn
cards.duration: Until end of current turn or until attack resolves
cards.effect: Empower your next weapon or touch attack this turn. On a hit, add damage equal to half the attack's unmodified rolled base damage dice total, rounded down, minimum 1. If that attack is a critical hit, the target makes a Constitution save; on failure it would be Stunned until the end of its next turn, subject to the Oracle hard-control guard.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Ancestor; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Ancestral Strike
value.description: Spend 1 charge to channel a warrior ancestor. Next weapon or touch attack deals +50% bonus weapon damage and stuns on crit.

cards.name: Bloodline Sight
cards.effect: For 2 rounds you perceive undead, invisible and ethereal creatures within 6 tiles that are not behind total cover or an effect explicitly blocking supernatural detection. Those creatures cannot gain concealment or hide from you solely through invisibility, ethereal overlap or mundane Stealth while in range. This does not expose illusions unrelated to those categories.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Ancestor; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Bloodline Sight
value.description: Spend 1 charge to reveal all undead, invisible, or ethereal creatures within 6 tiles for 2 rounds; they cannot benefit from concealment or stealth.

cards.name: Spirit Walk
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.effect: Your spirit leaves your body until the end of the turn. During the effect you may move through creatures and nonmagical solid barriers, ignore difficult terrain and cannot be targeted by attacks or effects that require a physical target. You may activate one other known Revelation at its normal RC cost while in spirit form. You cannot manipulate physical objects or make weapon attacks. At turn end choose your original space or a legal unoccupied space you reached; if none is legal, return to the original space. Your physical body remains in its original space and can still be attacked normally; damage and conditions on either form affect your one character. The optional Revelation uses its normal activation and cost: this feature grants no free Action. Ending in an occupied or illegal space returns the spirit to its body.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Ancestor; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Spirit Walk
value.description: Spend 2 charges: leave your body for 1 turn — intangible, move through walls/creatures, cannot be targeted, may cast a Revelation through your spirit at full range.

cards.name: Echo Armor
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.frequency: Damage reduction always; death prevention 1/short rest
cards.effect: Reduce the first nonmagical weapon damage you take each round by PB, minimum 0. Once per short rest, when damage would reduce you to 0 HP without killing you outright, remain at 1 HP instead. The prevention removes no Wounds and cannot trigger if another effect has already prevented that same reduction to 0.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Ancestor; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Echo Armor
value.description: +10% resistance to non-magical damage. Once per short rest, when reduced to 0 HP, an ancestral echo absorbs the blow and leaves you at 1 HP.

cards.name: Ghost Chant
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.rangeAndTarget: Enemies of your choice within 3 tiles
cards.effect: Each target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it suffers Dread: -1 on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of its next turn. At the end of that turn it repeats the save, ending Dread on success; failure extends Dread one final round. This is fear-based and a creature immune to fear is immune.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Ancestor; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Ghost Chant
value.description: Spend 2 charges to inflict Dread on enemies within 3 tiles (−10% hit chance and saves for 2 turns).

cards.name: Bloodline Convergence
cards.effect: For 2 rounds, once on each of your regular turns you gain one additional full Action usable only to activate a Revelation or Dash/Move, subject to the universal extra-Action cap. Allies within 5 tiles gain +1 on attack rolls, reduce the first damage they take each round by S and are immune to Frightened. Once per round you may activate one known Tier I Ancestor Revelation for 0 RC; it still uses its normal action type. When Convergence ends you are suffering Revelation backlash until the end of your next turn: -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and Speed -5 feet. Concentration is required. At most three chosen allies gain its aura. The free Tier I activation uses its ordinary action type and shares the two-Revelation ceiling.

value.name: Bloodline Convergence
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, +2 actions per turn (Revelation or movement only); allies within 5 tiles gain +10% crit, +5% DR, immunity to Fear; cast 1 Revelation per round at no cost. After: Exhausted (−1 action, −10% resist for 1 round).

cards.name: Ancestral Whispers
cards.effect: Gain advantage on History checks and you cannot be Surprised while conscious. Once per long rest, spend 1 minute consulting your ancestors about one specific person, place, object or course of action. The Director provides one truthful cryptic clue drawn from knowledge the ancestral spirits could reasonably possess; they do not reveal unknowable future decisions.

value.name: Ancestral Whispers
value.description: Advantage on History checks and immunity to surprise. Once per day, consult ancestors for cryptic but useful guidance.

cards.name: Ancestor Revelation Mastery
cards.acquisition: choose one eligible enhancement at Oracle 15
cards.effect: Choose exactly one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Echo Voice: when Echo Voice triggers, you may spend 1 additional RC to let up to M qualifying allies within 5 tiles each reroll one failed roll caused by the same event, using +2. Enhanced Spirit Walk: Spirit Walk lasts until the end of your next regular turn, but you still may activate at most one additional Revelation during the extended walk. Enhanced Bloodline Convergence: remove its post-effect suffering Revelation backlash drawback.

value: Enhanced Echo Voice: affects all allies within range simultaneously
Enhanced Spirit Walk: duration increased to 2 turns
Enhanced Bloodline Convergence: no longer causes Exhaustion

cards.name: Ancestral Confluence
cards.duration: Chosen Revelation plus cost reduction until end of your next regular turn
cards.effect: When activating a known Ancestor Revelation, reduce its RC cost to 0. Until the end of your next regular turn, your other Ancestor Revelations cost 1 less RC, minimum 0. A Revelation can receive this reduction once per activation and no free or reduced activation can recursively restore RC from its own copied effects.

value.name: Ancestral Confluence
value.description: Once per day, call all ancestors to cast any Revelation at no charge cost. For 1 turn after, all Revelations cost 1 fewer charge (minimum 0).

cards.name: Echo Crowned
cards.cost: 0 RC to maintain spirits; Revelation costs normally unless stated
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; death prevention ally within 5 tiles
cards.frequency: Double-cast 1/long rest; each spirit may be sacrificed once per long rest
cards.effect: Maintain three named ancestral Echoes: Offense grants +1 on your first Revelation attack each round; Defense reduces the first damage you take each round by S; Utility grants advantage on one History, Insight or Perception check per round. Once per long rest, when you activate a known Revelation, you may pay its RC cost twice and resolve it twice as part of the same action against different legal targets; copied resolution cannot duplicate resource or action triggers. You may sacrifice one currently available Echo as a Reaction when an ally within 5 tiles would be reduced to 0 HP to leave that ally at 1 HP instead, or as a Bonus Action to restore your RC to maximum. A sacrificed Echo provides no passive benefit until your next long rest.

value.name: Echo Crowned
value.description: Maintain 3 passive ancestral spirits (offense, defense, utility). Once per day, cast any Revelation twice in one turn using different Echoes. Sacrifice an Echo to prevent a party member's death or restore all Revelation Charges.

cards.name: Battle Prophecy Trigger
cards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
cards.effect: When you or an ally reduces a meaningful hostile creature to 0 HP, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. Summoned, trivial, friendly or repeatedly revived creatures do not qualify.

originalObjects.value: When you or an ally drops an enemy to 0 HP, regain 1 Revelation Charge

cards.name: Omen of the Host
cards.duration: Passive permanent; oath until start of your next turn
cards.effect: Gain +1 on your first weapon or Revelation attack roll each round, +1 on saves against Frightened and you cannot be Surprised while conscious. Once per short rest as a Bonus Action choose one ally within 3 tiles; it gains +2 initiative for the current encounter, advantage on its next attack before the start of your next turn and reduces the first damage it takes before then by S.

value.name: Omen of the Host
value.description: Passive: you gain +1 to hit on your first attack each round, +5% resistance to fear, and cannot be surprised while conscious. Once per short rest, whisper a battle-oath to an ally within 3 tiles — they gain +2 initiative, advantage on their next attack, and +5% DR until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Vanguard's Step
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self and one willing ally within 3 tiles
cards.duration: Movement instantaneous; protection until start of your next turn
cards.effect: You and the ally may each immediately move up to 2 tiles without provoking opportunity attacks. The ally reduces the first damage it takes before the start of your next turn by S. Until the end of the current turn, both of you gain advantage on your next opportunity attack, if any.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Battle; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Vanguard's Step
value.description: Spend 1 charge: you and one ally within 3 tiles may immediately move up to 2 tiles without provoking attacks; the ally gains +5% DR until start of your next turn and you both have advantage on opportunity attacks made before end of turn.

cards.name: Host's Cry
cards.effect: Allies in range gain +S damage on one weapon hit per turn and reduce the first damage they take each round by 1. Once during this Cry, when a qualifying ally reduces a meaningful hostile creature to 0 HP, that ally regains 1d6 HP and you regain 1 RC, never above maximum. This special refund can occur only once per Host's Cry and still obeys the once-per-round RC recovery ceiling.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Battle; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Host's Cry
value.description: Spend 1 charge: allies within 4 tiles gain +10% weapon damage and +5% DR for 2 rounds as the War Chorus roars through you; the first ally to drop an enemy while the cry persists regains 1d6 HP and you regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per cry).

cards.name: Mark of the Doomed
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy you can see within 5 tiles
cards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one active mark at a time
cards.effect: Mark the target. You and allies within 5 tiles gain +2 on attack rolls against it. The first critical hit against the marked creature during the mark deals +1d6 damage of the triggering attack's type. The marked creature cannot benefit from mundane concealment against you. Applying another Mark of the Doomed ends the previous mark.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Battle; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Mark of the Doomed
value.description: Spend 1 charge: mark one enemy you can see for 2 rounds — you and allies within 5 tiles gain +2 to hit and +10% crit chance against them; the first attack that crits the mark deals +1d6 bonus damage and the marked target cannot benefit from concealment until the mark fades.

cards.name: Divine Fury
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.effect: For 2 rounds, once on each of your turns when a weapon or touch attack hits, add damage equal to half its unmodified base damage dice total, rounded down, minimum 1. Your attacks ignore 1 point of flat DR. When you critically hit, the target makes a Wisdom save; on failure it is Frightened until the end of its next turn. Once during each of your turns while Fury lasts, after your first weapon or touch attack hits, you may make one additional weapon or touch attack as a Bonus Action if you have not already used a Bonus Action that turn; this is not an extra full Action.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Battle; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Divine Fury
value.description: Spend 2 charges: for 2 rounds, your weapon and touch attacks deal +50% bonus weapon damage and ignore 5% DR; the War Chorus roars through each strike — on a critical hit, the target must save or suffer Fear (−10% hit) until end of next turn, and your second attack during the fury may be made as a bonus action if the first hit.

cards.name: Field Command
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.rangeAndTarget: One ally within 5 tiles; optional second ally within 5 tiles
cards.duration: Immediate action; protection until start of your next turn
cards.effect: Choose one willing ally. It may immediately use its Reaction to either move up to its Speed, make one ordinary weapon attack, or activate one class feature that normally uses an Action or Bonus Action. This counts as that creature's one possible additional full Action for the round where applicable. If it deals damage with the granted action, add S damage to one damage roll. It reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1. Before the command resolves, a second ally within range may move 1 tile without provoking opportunity attacks. The ally pays every ordinary resource cost, rest use and recharge and meets every prerequisite. This is one additional Action for the shared cap; it cannot activate an action-granting feature.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Battle; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Field Command
value.description: Spend 2 charges: one ally within 5 tiles may immediately take a reaction to attack, move, or activate a class feature; the War Chorus marks them with command — they gain +10% damage on that action, +5% DR until start of your next turn, and you may grant a second ally within 5 tiles a free 1-tile reposition without provoking before the command resolves.

cards.name: Relentless Strike
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.duration: Attack bonus until next qualifying attack; Fear until end next turn
cards.frequency: Miss benefit stacks once; RC recovery at most once per round
cards.effect: When you miss with a weapon or touch attack, gain +1 on your next such attack roll before the end of your next regular turn. If that empowered attack hits, add S damage. A second miss does not increase the bonus. When you score a critical hit, regain 1 RC at most once per round and the target makes a Wisdom save; on failure it is Frightened until the end of its next turn.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Battle; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Relentless Strike
value.description: Passive: when you miss with an attack, the War Chorus steels your next strike — gain +5% hit chance (stacks once) and +10% weapon damage if that attack hits. On a critical hit, regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round) and the target must save or suffer Fear (−10% hit) until end of next turn.

cards.name: Fury of the Host
cards.effect: For 2 rounds, each ally in range may once on its regular turn gain one additional full Action usable only for one ordinary weapon attack or Dash/Move, subject to the universal extra-Action cap. Allies also gain +1 on attack rolls and reduce the first damage they take each round by 1. You gain +2 AC and immunity to Frightened. Once per round you may activate one known Tier I Battle Revelation for 0 RC using its normal action type. The first qualifying ally each round to reduce a meaningful enemy to 0 HP regains 1d6 HP. When the effect ends, you are suffering Revelation backlash until the end of your next turn: -1 on attacks and saves and Speed -5 feet. Concentration is required; choose at most three allies for its benefits. Each granted Action may make only one ordinary weapon attack or Dash, and cannot grant another action.

value.name: Fury of the Host
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, allies within 5 tiles gain +1 action per turn (attack or move only), +10% crit chance, and +5% DR as the War Chorus banners them — you gain +2 AC and immunity to Fear; once per round you may cast one Tier I Battle Revelation at no cost, and the first ally to drop an enemy each round regains 1d6 HP. After: Exhausted (−1 action, −10% resist for 1 round).

cards.name: Battle-Seer's Eye
cards.duration: Permanent; AC benefit against one attack
cards.effect: Gain advantage on Perception and initiative rolls. Once per long rest when a visible enemy declares an attack against you or an ally within 5 tiles, use your Reaction before the roll; you and one ally within 5 tiles gain +2 AC against that enemy's next attack before the end of its current turn.

value.name: Battle-Seer's Eye
value.description: Advantage on Perception and Initiative. Once per day, foretell an enemy's opening strike — you and one ally gain +2 AC against that enemy's next attack.

cards.name: Battle Revelation Mastery
cards.acquisition: choose one eligible enhancement at Oracle 15
cards.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Host's Cry: its range becomes 6 tiles and its damage rider becomes +S+1 instead of +S. Enhanced Divine Fury: once per turn during Divine Fury, a third weapon or touch attack you make that turn may receive the Fury bonus damage, but the feature creates no additional attack beyond its printed Bonus Action attack. Enhanced Fury of the Host: remove its suffering Revelation backlash drawback.

value: Enhanced Host's Cry: bonus damage and DR extend to all allies within 6 tiles
Enhanced Divine Fury: affects a third attack
Enhanced Fury of the Host: no longer causes Exhaustion

cards.name: War Prophecy
cards.rangeAndTarget: One known Battle Revelation; allies within 5 tiles
cards.duration: Chosen Revelation; aura until end of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Activate one known Battle Revelation for 0 RC. Until the end of your next regular turn, allies within 5 tiles reduce the first damage they take by 1 and add S damage to one weapon hit. Your next Tier I Battle Revelation before the encounter ends costs 0 RC. That free Revelation cannot itself create another free-use chain.

value.name: War Prophecy
value.description: Once per day, the War Chorus speaks through you — cast any Battle Revelation at no charge cost. For 1 round after, allies within 5 tiles gain +5% DR and +10% weapon damage as the host's banners flare; your next Tier I Revelation this encounter costs 0 charges.

cards.name: Avatar of the War Chorus
cards.effect: Manifest three banners for 3 rounds. Offense Banner: once on each of your turns add 2 S damage to one weapon or Revelation damage roll. Defense Banner: gain +2 AC; allies within 5 tiles reduce first damage each round by 1. Rally Banner: once per round one ally within 5 tiles gains +1 on an attack roll made during its turn. Your known Tier I Battle Revelations cost 0 RC while all three banners remain. You may sacrifice one banner as a Reaction to leave an ally within 5 tiles at 1 HP instead of 0, or as a Bonus Action to restore your RC to maximum; that banner's benefit ends immediately. When the 3-round effect ends naturally, regain 2 RC, never above maximum. The Final grants no more than one additional full Action per creature per round.

value.name: Avatar of the War Chorus
value.description: Once per day, manifest three War Chorus banners (offense, defense, rally) around you for 3 rounds: +2 AC, +2 attacks per turn, and all Tier I Revelations cost 0 charges. Allies within 5 tiles gain +5% DR and +10% weapon damage as the host answers; sacrifice a banner to prevent a party member's death or restore all Revelation Charges. When the banners fall, restore 2 Revelation Charges.

cards.name: Bones Prophecy Trigger
cards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
cards.effect: When an undead creature or meaningful hostile creature at 0 HP within 5 tiles dies, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. Summoned, friendly, trivial or repeatedly revived creatures cannot trigger this recovery.

originalObjects.value: When an undead creature or a dying foe within 5 tiles perishes, regain 1 Revelation Charge

cards.name: Grave Attendant
cards.effect: Uncontrolled undead within 3 tiles that have no specific reason to attack you begin neutral rather than automatically hostile, and you reduce the first necrotic damage you take each round by PB. Once per long rest as an Action animate one Small or Medium corpse within 2 tiles as a 1-HP skeletal attendant for up to 3 rounds. It cannot attack. Once before it expires, when a single-target attack would hit you, the attendant intercepts it and is destroyed. It grants no XP, loot, corpse resource or RC.

value.name: Grave Attendant
value.description: Passive: undead within 3 tiles treat you as neutral unless attacked, and you gain +5% resistance to necrotic damage. Once per long rest, animate one corpse within 2 tiles as a skeletal servant (1 HP, 1 attack) for 3 rounds — it intercepts the next single-target hit meant for you before crumbling.

cards.name: Bone Whisper
cards.cost: 1 RC for active suppression; corpse speech costs 0 RC
cards.rangeAndTarget: One corpse touched; undead within 2 tiles for active effect
cards.duration: Corpse conversation maximum 1 minute; suppression until end of your next turn
cards.frequency: Corpse speech 1/corpse; active at will while RC remains
cards.effect: You may ask a corpse up to three brief questions about events it personally perceived while alive; it answers from its own knowledge and cannot speculate. Separately, spend 1 RC as an Action; undead enemies within 2 tiles make Wisdom saves. On failure they would be Incapacitated until the end of your next turn, subject to the Oracle hard-control guard. On a later qualifying failure after the guard has been used, they instead lose Reactions and their Speed becomes 0 for that duration.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Bones; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Bone Whisper
value.description: Passive: speak with corpses and recent dead as if under Speak with Dead. Active: spend 1 charge to learn one hidden truth a corpse witnessed before death; undead within 2 tiles must save or become unable to act until end of your next turn as the Pale Ledger speaks through the bones.

cards.name: Marrow Drain
cards.duration: Instantaneous; healing lock until end of your next turn against undead
cards.effect: Make a Revelation attack. On hit deal 2d6 necrotic damage and regain HP equal to half the actual damage dealt, rounded down, maximum S+M HP. Against undead, deal 3d6 necrotic instead and the target cannot regain HP until the end of your next turn. Constructs are immune to the healing-drain portion. This healing removes no Wounds.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Bones; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Marrow Drain
value.description: Spend 1 charge: touch attack deals 2d6 necrotic damage and you heal for half damage dealt; undead targets take +50% damage and cannot regain HP until end of your next turn as the Pale Ledger tallies their debt.

cards.name: Ashen Shroud
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; enemies within 2 tiles; corpses within 2 tiles when effect ends
cards.effect: For 2 rounds reduce the first nonmagical weapon damage you take each round by S and reduce the first necrotic damage you take each round by S. Enemies within 2 tiles suffer -1 on attack rolls and -1 on saves against fear. When the Shroud ends, corpses within 2 tiles cannot be raised or converted into undead for 1 hour unless an effect specifically overrides Oracle corpse wards.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Bones; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Ashen Shroud
value.description: Spend 1 charge: cloak yourself in grave-dust for 2 rounds — +10% DR vs non-magical damage, +5% necrotic resistance, and enemies within 2 tiles suffer −10% hit chance and −10% saves vs fear; when the shroud ends, corpses within 2 tiles cannot be raised as undead for 1 hour.

cards.name: Ledger's Command
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.effect: Each target makes a Wisdom save if hostile or unwilling; willing undead may waive it. On failure you command it for 2 rounds. Once per round as a Bonus Action, command one controlled undead to move up to its Speed and make one ordinary attack, using its own statistics; this obeys the universal one-extra-action limit and all controlled undead share that single Bonus Action command. Controlled undead reduce their first damage each round by 1. Once during the command, one controlled expendable undead may intercept a single-target attack against you and be reduced to 0 HP after absorbing it. This feature creates no corpse, loot or RC farm. Eligible targets are nonlegendary undead of challenge rating no greater than half your Oracle level (round down), with Wisdom saves initially and at each turn end. Commanding uses your shared companion Bonus Action; only one commanded undead makes one attack per round, capped at S d8+M damage with no monster multiattack, recharge or spell resources. Commanding a hostile undead to spend its Action consumes its one hard-denial allowance; later control can only deny Reactions and reduce Speed to 0 on a failed save, never command another Action.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Bones; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Ledger's Command
value.description: Spend 2 charges: command up to 2 undead within 4 tiles for 2 rounds — each may attack once per round using your Revelation with +10% damage; commanded undead gain +5% DR and one may intercept the next single-target hit meant for you before crumbling (once per command).

cards.name: Rotting Touch
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.effect: Make a Revelation attack. On hit the target makes a Constitution save. On failure it gains Decay for up to 3 rounds: attacks against it add S damage once per attacker per turn, it takes -1 on saving throws and cannot regain HP. At the end of each turn it repeats the save, ending Decay on success. Corpses within 2 tiles of a Decayed creature cannot be raised while Decay persists. If the target is undead, it also takes 2d6 necrotic damage on the initial hit and you regain half the actual damage dealt, capped at S+M HP. At most three allied hits per round receive the vulnerability rider; it is additional flat damage, not multiplication of an entire attack.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Bones; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Rotting Touch
value.description: Spend 2 charges: touch attack inflicts Decay — target takes +25% damage from all sources and −10% saves for 3 rounds; the Pale Ledger tallies their rot — on a failed save they also cannot regain HP and corpses within 2 tiles of them cannot be raised as undead until Decay ends; if the target is undead, they take 2d6 necrotic immediately and you heal half.

cards.name: Death's Threshold
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.duration: Until healed above half maximum HP
cards.effect: The first time after a short rest that you fall to one-quarter maximum HP or less, activate Death's Threshold. Until you are healed above half maximum HP, reduce the first necrotic damage and first nonmagical weapon damage you take each round by S and gain +1 to your Revelation save DC. Undead enemies within 3 tiles take -1 on their first attack roll against you each round. The effect then ends and cannot reactivate until after another short rest.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Bones; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Death's Threshold
value.description: When reduced below 25% HP, gain +10% necrotic resistance, +5% DR vs non-magical damage, and +1 to Revelation saves until healed above half HP (once per short rest) — the Pale Ledger marks you as owed, not finished; undead within 3 tiles hesitate to target you (−10% hit on their first attack each round while below threshold).

cards.name: Unfinished Chorus
cards.rangeAndTarget: Enemies, controlled undead and corpses within 4 tiles
cards.effect: For 2 rounds, enemies within 4 tiles suffer Dread: -1 on attack rolls and saving throws. Once on each of your turns choose one living enemy in range; it takes 1d6 necrotic damage and you either regain half the actual damage dealt, rounded down, or one living ally within 3 tiles of you regains that amount, maximum S+M HP. Undead you control add S damage to one attack each turn and reduce first damage each round by 1. Corpses in the area cannot be raised while the Chorus lasts. Afterward you are suffering Revelation backlash until end of your next turn: -1 attacks/saves and Speed -5 feet. Choose up to three enemies and three allies. Enemies make Wisdom saves on entry and at the end of each turn, ending their debuff on success. The drain allows a Constitution save for half damage; healing is capped at S+M total per pulse. Concentration and pulse upkeep apply.

value.name: Unfinished Chorus
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, all enemies within 4 tiles suffer Dread (−10% hit/saves) as the Pale Ledger sings their unfinished deaths — once per round drain 1d6 HP from one target (heal half or redirect half to an ally within 3 tiles); undead you control gain +10% damage and +5% DR, and corpses within 4 tiles cannot be raised as undead until the chorus ends. After: Exhausted (−1 action, −10% necrotic resist for 1 round).

cards.name: Ledger's Memory
cards.effect: Gain advantage on checks to identify undead, poison and disease. Once per long rest, touch one corpse and learn its identity if the Pale Ledger could reasonably know it, its approximate time of death and the direct physical or magical cause of death. This does not reveal the killer's identity unless the corpse or supernatural Ledger actually knows it.

value.name: Ledger's Memory
value.description: Advantage on checks to identify undead, poison, and disease. Once per day, consult the Pale Ledger for the name and cause of death of any corpse you touch.

cards.name: Bones Revelation Mastery
cards.acquisition: choose one eligible enhancement at Oracle 15
cards.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Marrow Drain: a living target hit also has Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of its next turn. Enhanced Ledger's Command: may target up to 3 undead, but all controlled undead still share one Bonus Action command per round. Enhanced Unfinished Chorus: when its drain resolves, you may always redirect the healing to one ally within 3 tiles of you rather than yourself; its healing cap remains S+M.

value: Enhanced Marrow Drain: also slows target movement by 1 tile
Enhanced Ledger's Command: affects 3 undead
Enhanced Unfinished Chorus: you may redirect drained HP to an ally within 3 tiles

cards.name: Death's Prophecy
cards.rangeAndTarget: One known Bones Revelation; self and allies within 3 tiles
cards.duration: Chosen Revelation; ward until end of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Activate one known Bones Revelation for 0 RC. Until the end of your next regular turn, you and allies within 3 tiles reduce the first necrotic damage you each take by S. This ward is damage reduction, not immunity, and does not stack with itself.

value.name: Death's Prophecy
value.description: Once per day, cast any Bones Revelation at no cost. For 1 round, you and allies within 3 tiles gain +10% DR vs necrotic.

cards.name: Ledger Unbound
cards.rangeAndTarget: Enemies and up to 3 eligible corpses within 5 tiles
cards.effect: Choose up to three enemies in range. Roll 4 S d8+M once; each target takes necrotic damage equal to the lesser of that roll or one-quarter its maximum HP, with a Constitution save for half. This blast cannot reduce HP below 1. Raise up to three nonsummoned corpses as 1-HP bone servants for three rounds. Once per round spend your shared companion Bonus Action to move and attack with ONE servant using your Revelation attack bonus for 1d8+S necrotic damage. Alternatively, your Reaction may sacrifice one servant to intercept a single-target attack against you; no attack is made by that servant that round. Servants grant no XP, loot, harvestable corpses or RC. For three rounds, up to three undead you already control add S damage to their one shared commanded attack and reduce the first damage they take each round by 1. No extra creature turns or command budgets are created.

value.name: Ledger Unbound
value.description: Once per day, open the Pale Ledger across the battlefield — all enemies within 5 tiles must save or suffer 25% max HP necrotic damage as unfinished deaths are tallied; you may raise up to 3 fallen corpses as loyal bone servants for 3 rounds (each may attack once per round and intercept one hit meant for you). Undead you control during the effect gain +10% damage and +5% DR.

cards.name: Cataclysm Prophecy Trigger
cards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
cards.effect: When one of your Revelations deals damage to at least two meaningful hostile creatures as part of the same area effect, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. Repeated pulses of the same Revelation can trigger this at most once per round.

originalObjects.value: When you deal area damage to 2 or more enemies with a Revelation, regain 1 Revelation Charge

cards.name: Tremor Sense
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; enemies within 2 tiles for tremor
cards.duration: Permanent; tremor penalties until end of your next turn
cards.effect: While touching the ground or a structure, you can identify obvious structural instability, hollow spaces and hidden passages within 3 tiles that transmit vibration, subject to ordinary concealment and construction. Reduce the first bludgeoning damage you take each round by 1. Once per short rest as an Action, enemies within 2 tiles make Strength saves; on failure they fall Prone, and on success their Speed is reduced by 1 tile until the end of your next turn.

value.name: Tremor Sense
value.description: Passive: detect structural instability and hidden passages within 3 tiles, and +5% resistance to bludgeoning damage. Once per short rest, cause a minor tremor — enemies within 2 tiles must save or fall prone; on success they still suffer −1 movement until your next turn.

cards.name: Shardburst
cards.duration: Damage instantaneous; Speed reduction until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: Enemies in the burst make Dexterity saves, taking 1d6+M bludgeoning damage on failure or half on success. A creature that fails also has Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of its next turn. If a failing creature is adjacent to a wall, rubble or substantial stone terrain, it also makes a Strength save; failure knocks it Prone.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Shardburst
value.description: Spend 1 charge: erupt stone shards in a 2-tile burst centered on a point within 4 tiles — enemies take 1d6 bludgeoning and suffer −1 movement for 1 round; on a failed save they also fall prone if adjacent to a wall or rubble.

cards.name: Gale of Unmaking
cards.duration: Damage/movement instantaneous; difficult terrain until start of your next turn
cards.effect: Enemies in the line make Strength saves, taking 1d6+M bludgeoning damage and being pushed 1 tile on failure, or half damage with no push on success. Failed targets also have Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of their next turn. Mundane exposed flames in the line are extinguished. Loose natural debris in the line becomes difficult terrain until the start of your next turn.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Gale of Unmaking
value.description: Spend 1 charge: unleash a 4-tile line of forceful wind — enemies in the path take 1d6 bludgeoning, are pushed 1 tile, and suffer −1 movement until your next turn; mundane flames are extinguished and loose debris becomes difficult terrain for 1 round.

cards.name: Fault Line
cards.rangeAndTarget: 3-tile line of ground beginning within 4 tiles
cards.effect: The line becomes difficult terrain for 3 rounds. The first time each round an enemy enters the line or starts its turn there, it takes 1d4 bludgeoning damage and, if adjacent to a wall or substantial structure, makes a Strength save; failure knocks it Prone. Ordinary structures along the line may develop superficial or tactical cracks at Director discretion, but the Revelation cannot automatically destroy major structures or bypass scenario-critical barriers.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Fault Line
value.description: Spend 1 charge: erupt a 3-tile line of cracked earth for 3 rounds — difficult terrain; enemies entering or starting turn there take 1d4 bludgeoning and must save or fall prone if adjacent to a wall; structures along the line may develop cracks (DM discretion).

cards.name: Upheaval
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.duration: Instantaneous; ally protection until start of your next turn
cards.effect: Enemies in the burst make Strength saves. On failure they take 2d6+M bludgeoning damage and fall Prone; on success they take half damage and remain standing. Allies you choose in the burst are immune to this Prone effect and reduce the first damage they take before the start of your next turn by 1. Structures may crack at Director discretion but are not automatically destroyed.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Upheaval
value.description: Spend 2 charges: erupt a 3-tile burst earthquake — enemies save or fall prone and take 2d6 bludgeoning damage; structures may crack (DM discretion); allies in the burst are immune to prone and gain +5% DR until start of your next turn as the Shattered Seal's tremor passes through them.

cards.name: Storm Crown
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.effect: Choose lightning or thunder when activated. At the start of each of your regular turns while Storm Crown persists, enemies within 3 tiles make Dexterity saves, taking 2d6 damage of the chosen type on failure or half on success. A creature failing the save takes -1 on its first attack roll that turn. Allies in the aura reduce the first ranged-attack damage they take each round by 1 and have advantage on saves against weather-based Prone effects.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Storm Crown
value.description: Spend 2 charges: crown yourself in the Shattered Seal's storm for 2 rounds — at start of each of your turns, enemies within 3 tiles take 2d6 lightning or thunder damage (your choice) and must save or suffer −10% hit until end of turn; allies in the storm gain +5% DR vs ranged attacks and cannot be knocked prone by weather.

cards.name: Instability
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creatures within 1 tile of you after an enemy damages you
cards.duration: Instantaneous; ally protection until start of your next turn
cards.effect: When an enemy deals actual damage to you, spend 1 RC. Hostile creatures within 1 tile make Strength saves. Each takes force damage equal to half the actual triggering damage rounded down, maximum Oracle level, on failure or half that amount on success; a failing creature also falls Prone. Allies within the burst take no damage and reduce their first damage before the start of your next turn by 1. Reflected damage cannot trigger another reflection, RC refund or recursive damage effect.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Cataclysm; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Instability
value.description: Passive: when you take damage from an enemy, you may spend 1 charge as a reaction to fracture the Shattered Seal's wound — deal half that damage back as force in a 1-tile burst (once per round); enemies in the burst must save or fall prone, and allies in the burst gain +5% DR until start of your next turn as the tremor passes through them.

cards.name: Seal's Fracture
cards.effect: Choose Earthquake, Storm or Fire. The zone becomes difficult terrain. At activation and at the start of your next regular turn, enemies in the zone make Dexterity saves, taking 2d6 damage on failure or half on success: bludgeoning for Earthquake, lightning for Storm, fire for Fire. Until the zone ends, enemies inside take -1 on saving throws against your Cataclysm Revelations; allies inside reduce first damage each round by 1 and cannot be knocked Prone by this zone. Difficult terrain expands 1 tile outward after the second pulse but deals no extra damage there. Structures may crack at Director discretion. When the effect ends you are suffering Revelation backlash until end of your next turn: -1 attacks/saves and Speed -5 feet.

value.name: Seal's Fracture
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, once per turn create a 4-tile cataclysm zone (earthquake, storm, or fire — choose when cast) as the Shattered Seal weeps — enemies inside take 2d6 damage each round and suffer −10% saves; allies inside gain +5% DR and cannot be knocked prone by the zone; difficult terrain spreads 1 tile outward each round and structures inside may crack (DM discretion). After: Exhausted (−1 action, −10% resist for 1 round).

cards.name: Wound of Creation
cards.effect: Gain advantage on checks involving geology, storms, earthquakes, structural stability and unstable terrain. Once per long rest spend an Action to sense the nearest significant structural weak point, unstable surface, hidden fracture or likely collapse point within 10 tiles that is physically connected to your surroundings. You learn direction and broad nature, not an automatic method to destroy it.

value.name: Wound of Creation
value.description: Advantage on checks involving geology, storms, or the Descent's unstable floors. Once per day, sense the nearest structural weak point within 10 tiles.

cards.name: Cataclysm Revelation Mastery
cards.acquisition: choose one eligible enhancement at Oracle 15
cards.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Shardburst: increase its burst radius by 1 tile. Enhanced Upheaval: allies in the burst are also immune to Prone from other nonmagical ground effects until the start of your next turn. Enhanced Seal's Fracture: duration becomes 3 rounds and gains a third normal pulse at the start of your second later regular turn; repeat saves occur normally.

value: Enhanced Shardburst: radius +1 tile
Enhanced Upheaval: allies in burst are immune to prone
Enhanced Seal's Fracture: duration increased to 3 turns

cards.name: Cataclysm Prophecy
cards.duration: Chosen Revelation; empowerment until one later qualifying area resolves
cards.effect: Activate one known Cataclysm Revelation for 0 RC. Before the encounter ends, the next damaging area effect created by one of your Cataclysm Revelations adds one extra die matching its primary damage die to one shared damage roll. Creatures failing that effect's normal save also make a Strength save; failure knocks them Prone. Structures may crack at Director discretion but are not automatically destroyed.

value.name: Cataclysm Prophecy
value.description: Once per day, the Shattered Seal weeps through you — cast any Cataclysm Revelation at no charge cost. For 1 round after, the next area effect you create this encounter deals +25% damage and enemies inside must save or fall prone; structures in the zone may crack (DM discretion).

cards.name: The Unbound Wound
cards.effect: Create a cataclysm zone. At activation and at the start of each of your next two regular turns, enemies in the zone make Dexterity saves. Roll 2 S d8 once each pulse; half the rolled damage is bludgeoning and half, rounded down, is your choice of fire, lightning or force. Failure takes full damage; success takes half. The zone is difficult terrain and creatures failing by 10 or more also fall Prone. For the duration you are immune to force and bludgeoning damage originating from your own Cataclysm Revelations and resistant to other force/bludgeoning damage. Major structures are affected only according to Director-defined durability, never automatically erased. Afterward you are suffering Revelation backlash until end of your next turn.

value.name: The Unbound Wound
value.description: Once per day, tear open a fragment of the Shattered Seal and let its buried violence answer — create a 5-tile cataclysm for 3 rounds, dealing heavy mixed damage each round. You gain immunity to force and bludgeoning for the duration. After: Exhausted for 1 round.

cards.name: Dream Prophecy Trigger
cards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
cards.effect: When one of your Dream Revelations successfully imposes a condition or creates an illusion that a meaningful hostile creature fails a save against, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. Multiple targets failing the same Revelation restore only 1 RC.

originalObjects.value: When you impose a condition or illusion on an enemy, regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round)

cards.name: Dreamer's Veil
cards.effect: Gain +1 on saves against Charm and Illusion effects and advantage on saves against magical sleep. Once per long rest as an Action, choose one willing ally within 3 tiles; it becomes Invisible until it attacks, deals damage, forces a saving throw or 2 rounds pass. The first damaging attack it lands while still benefiting from concealment adds S d6 psychic damage. The bonus occurs once per use.

value.name: Dreamer's Veil
value.description: Passive: +5% resistance to charm and illusion, and advantage on saves vs sleep. Once per long rest, wrap an ally within 3 tiles in a waking dream — they become invisible until they attack or 2 rounds pass; their first attack from concealment this encounter deals +25% psychic damage.

cards.name: Mirage
cards.rangeAndTarget: One unoccupied space within 3 tiles of you
cards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Mirage at a time
cards.effect: Create one illusory duplicate. Once each round when a creature that can see the duplicate targets you with an attack, it makes a Wisdom save before rolling. On failure it targets the Mirage instead; the attack automatically misses you and destroys the Mirage. On success it targets normally. At the start of each of your turns the Mirage may move 1 tile without provoking. Area effects ignore the duplicate.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Mirage
value.description: Spend 1 charge: create an illusory duplicate within 3 tiles for 2 rounds — enemies must save to distinguish real from false when targeting you; on a failed save they strike the mirage instead, and the duplicate may move 1 tile each round without provoking as a free action.

cards.name: Slumber Glimpse
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn
cards.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it would lose its next Action, subject to the Oracle hard-control guard; it also loses Reactions and takes -2 on its next initiative adjustment or initiative check before the end of the encounter. The next attack against it before the end of its next turn gains +2 to hit. On a target already protected by the hard-control guard, failure instead removes Reactions and reduces Speed to 0 until the end of its next turn.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Slumber Glimpse
value.description: Spend 1 charge: one enemy within 4 tiles must save or lose their next action as they stagger through a waking dream; on a failed save they also suffer −10% initiative and cannot take reactions until the dream passes, and the next attack against them gains +2 to hit.

cards.name: False Memory
cards.duration: Until end of target's next turn or until plainly disproven
cards.effect: Describe one brief plausible false event concerning the immediate scene, such as an ally moving away, a door opening or a visible attack already occurring. The target makes a Wisdom save. On failure it treats that event as true for tactical perception only until disproven or the duration ends; it loses Reactions and the next attack against it gains +2 to hit. The illusion cannot overwrite identity, compel self-harm, create permanent memories, change beliefs or force the target to surrender possessions.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: False Memory
value.description: Spend 1 charge: one creature within 3 tiles believes a brief false event occurred (e.g. ally fled, trap sprung, you already cast) for 1 round or until disproven; on a failed save they also suffer −10% initiative and cannot take reactions until the memory is shattered, and the next attack against them gains +2 to hit.

cards.name: Shared Dream
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 2 willing allies within 4 tiles
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn or until each target acts
cards.effect: Each target may immediately move up to 2 tiles without provoking opportunity attacks and gains concealment until it attacks, deals damage, forces a saving throw or the duration ends. The first damaging attack each target lands while concealed by Shared Dream adds S psychic damage once. This movement is not an additional full Action.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Shared Dream
value.description: Spend 2 charges: you and up to 2 allies within 4 tiles enter a lucid dream-state for 1 round — each may reposition up to 2 tiles without provoking and gains concealment until they act; when the dream ends, the first enemy each dreamer strikes deals +25% psychic damage as the Veiled Threshold bleeds waking into nightmare.

cards.name: Nightmare Lash
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.effect: The target makes a Wisdom save, taking 2d8+M psychic damage on failure or half on success. On failure it also suffers Dread: -1 on attack rolls and saving throws and no Reactions until the end of its next turn. It repeats the save then; failure extends the attack/save penalty one final round, but Reaction loss lasts only the first round. If the target was already Frightened or suffering Dread before the cast, add one extra d8 psychic damage and, after resolution, regain 1 RC at most once per round.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Nightmare Lash
value.description: Spend 2 charges: lash one enemy within 5 tiles with waking nightmare — 2d8 + Charisma modifier psychic damage; on failed save, target suffers Dread (−10% hit/saves) for 2 turns and cannot take reactions for 1 round; the Veiled Threshold shows you their dread — if they were already suffering Dread or fear, the lash deals +50% damage and you regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round).

cards.name: Unreality
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; attacker within normal attack range
cards.frequency: Passive avoidance once per round; vanish 1/short rest
cards.effect: Once per round when an enemy attack roll would hit you, roll d4; on 4 the attack instead hits an illusory echo and misses. Separately, once per short rest when an attack would deal damage to you, use your Reaction before damage to make that attack miss and teleport to an unoccupied space 1 tile away that you can perceive. The attacker then makes a Wisdom save; on failure it suffers Dread (-1 attack and save) until the end of its next turn.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Dream; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Unreality
value.description: Passive: when an enemy misses you with an attack, 25% chance they strike an illusory echo instead (once per round). Once per short rest, when you would take damage from an attack, you may instead vanish into unreality — the attack misses, you reappear 1 tile away, and the attacker must save or suffer Dread (−10% hit/saves) for 1 turn.

cards.name: Threshold Collapse
cards.effect: For 2 rounds, enemies in the aura take -1 on attack rolls and cannot gain advantage solely from flanking. Allies in the aura gain +1 on saves against Charm and Fear. Once per round at the start of one enemy's turn in the aura, choose that enemy; it makes a Wisdom save. On failure choose one ally in the aura: that enemy treats the chosen ally as visually absent until the start of its next turn and cannot target that ally with attacks requiring sight, though area effects remain legal. When a hostile creature makes the first save to disbelieve one of your Dream illusions inside the aura, success requires a second Wisdom save; failing either means it remains deceived for that illusion's normal duration.

value.name: Threshold Collapse
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, enemies within 4 tiles suffer −10% hit chance and cannot benefit from flanking — allies within the zone gain +10% saves vs charm and fear; reality frays at the edges: once per round an enemy inside must save or believe an ally is absent (attacks vs that ally have disadvantage until disproven), and your illusions inside the zone require a second save to disbelieve.

cards.name: Lucid Oracle
cards.effect: Gain advantage on saves against magical sleep and Illusion effects. Once per long rest spend 10 minutes asking the Veiled Threshold one specific question concerning the present situation or a contemplated course of action. Receive one truthful symbolic vision or omen. It cannot reveal another player's unknowable future choice.

value.name: Lucid Oracle
value.description: Advantage on saves vs sleep and illusion. Once per day, ask the Veiled Threshold one question — receive a symbolic but truthful vision.

cards.name: Dream Revelation Mastery
cards.acquisition: choose one eligible enhancement at Oracle 15
cards.effect: Choose one mastery for a Revelation you know. Enhanced Mirage: create two duplicates; each can absorb one failed-targeting attack and both share the same 2-round duration. Enhanced Shared Dream: affect up to 3 allies plus yourself. Enhanced Threshold Collapse: enemies inside the aura cannot take Reactions while they are currently deceived by one of your Dream illusions or while suffering Dread from you.

value: Enhanced Mirage: creates 2 duplicates
Enhanced Shared Dream: affects 3 allies
Enhanced Threshold Collapse: enemies cannot use reactions inside the zone

cards.name: Dream Prophecy
cards.duration: Chosen Revelation; invisibility until attack or end of next turn
cards.effect: Activate one known Dream Revelation for 0 RC. After it resolves, become Invisible until you attack, deal damage, force a saving throw or the end of your next regular turn. The first damaging attack you land from that concealment adds S d6 psychic damage and causes the target to make a Wisdom save; on failure it suffers Dread (-1 attack and save) until the end of its next turn. During the same interval, when a creature succeeds on its first save to disbelieve one illusion you create, require a second Wisdom save; it must succeed on both to disbelieve.

value.name: Dream Prophecy
value.description: Once per day, the Veiled Threshold parts — cast any Dream Revelation at no charge cost. For 1 round after, all illusions you create require a second save to disbelieve, and enemies who fail their first save against your illusions suffer −10% hit until end of next turn.

cards.name: The Waking Lie
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 4 contiguous tiles within 6 tiles
cards.effect: Designate up to 4 contiguous tiles as dream-space for 3 rounds. Allies in those tiles have concealment. When an enemy first tries each round to directly target an ally in dream-space using sight, it makes a Wisdom save; on failure that ally appears absent and cannot be the target of that specific attack or sight-dependent effect, though the enemy may choose another legal target or use an area effect. On success it perceives normally for that attempt. When the dream-space ends, enemies currently inside make Wisdom saves, taking 3 S d6 psychic damage on failure or half on success. This cannot erase terrain, creatures, memory, ownership or objective reality.

value.name: The Waking Lie
value.description: Once per day, rewrite one battlefield truth for 3 rounds: designate up to 4 tiles as 'dream' — enemies treat allies there as absent; allies gain concealment. Reality reasserts painfully when it ends (enemies save or take psychic damage).

cards.name: Flame Prophecy Trigger
cards.frequency: At most once per round during a real encounter
cards.effect: When one of your Revelations restores HP to a living ally or deals fire damage to a meaningful hostile creature, regain 1 RC, never above maximum. One Revelation use can restore at most 1 RC even if it both heals and burns or affects multiple targets.

originalObjects.value: When you heal an ally or burn an enemy with a Revelation, regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round)

cards.name: Ember Mantle
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; allies within 2 tiles during ignition
cards.effect: Gain fire resistance and add S HP to the first external healing effect that restores HP to you each round. Once per long rest ignite the Mantle for 2 rounds. Once per round when a creature within melee reach damages you with a melee attack, it takes 1d4 fire damage. You shed bright light in 2 tiles, and allies there gain +1 on saves against Frightened.

value.name: Ember Mantle
value.description: Passive: resistance to fire damage and +5% healing received. Once per long rest, ignite your ember mantle for 2 rounds — melee attackers take 1d4 fire damage on hit, you emit warm light in a 2-tile radius, and allies there gain +5% saves vs fear.

cards.name: Wrathful Brand
cards.duration: Until end of your next regular turn
cards.frequency: At will while RC remains; one Brand at a time
cards.effect: Mark one enemy. The next damaging attack you hit it with before the Brand ends adds fire damage equal to half that attack's unmodified rolled base damage dice total, rounded down, minimum 1. If an ally damages the marked target before the Brand ends, that ally regains 1d6 HP once per Brand and the target makes a Wisdom save; on failure it has -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Wrathful Brand
value.description: Spend 1 charge: mark one enemy with burning judgment for 1 round — your next attack against them deals +50% fire damage; if an ally attacks the marked target before the brand fades, they heal 1d6 and the target must save or suffer −10% hit until end of next round as cursed embers cling.

cards.name: Purging Flame
cards.duration: Instantaneous; attack penalty until end of undead target's next turn
cards.effect: If the target is a living ally, it regains 1d8+M HP and may end Poisoned or immediately repeat one saving throw against a disease that normally permits saves. This removes no Wounds. If the target is undead, make a Revelation attack; on hit it takes 1d8+M fire damage and makes a Constitution save, suffering -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn on failure.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Purging Flame
value.description: Spend 1 charge: touch one ally within 1 tile to end one disease or poison and heal 1d8 + your Charisma modifier; undead touched instead take equal fire damage and must save or suffer −10% hit for 1 round as cursed ash clings.

cards.name: Passion's Rush
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; move up to 3 tiles in a straight or bending legal path
cards.duration: Movement instantaneous; ally buff until start of your next turn
cards.effect: Move up to 3 tiles without provoking opportunity attacks. Each meaningful hostile creature whose space you pass adjacent to can be affected once and makes a Dexterity save, taking 1d6 fire damage on failure or half on success; a failed target also has Speed reduced by 1 tile until the end of its next turn. If you finish adjacent to an ally, that ally adds S damage to its next weapon hit and reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 3; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier I Revelation

value.name: Passion's Rush
value.description: Spend 1 charge: blaze up to 3 tiles in a line of harmless fire — enemies passed take 1d6 fire damage and must save or suffer −1 movement until your next turn; if you end adjacent to an ally, they gain +10% weapon damage and +5% DR for 1 round as embers cling to their weapons.

cards.name: Crown's Burn
cards.acquisition: choose first at Oracle 6; a distinct second at Oracle 13
cards.duration: Damage/healing instantaneous; penalties until end of next turn
cards.effect: Enemies in the burst make Dexterity saves, taking 2d6+M fire damage on failure or half on success. A failing enemy also has -1 on attack rolls until the end of its next turn. Total the actual fire damage dealt to meaningful hostile creatures, then divide by the number of allied recipients chosen in the burst; up to three living allies in the burst each regain the lesser of that share or S d6+M HP, minimum 1 if any qualifying damage was dealt. Each healed ally reduces the first fire damage it takes before your next turn by S.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Crown's Burn
value.description: Spend 2 charges: unleash a 3-tile burst of shard-fire — enemies take 2d6 fire damage and must save or suffer −10% hit until end of next turn; allies in the burst heal half the total damage dealt to enemies (minimum 1d6), and the Crown's embers cling — allies healed this way gain +5% DR vs fire until start of your next turn.

cards.name: Zealot's Renewal

cards.rangeAndTarget: One living ally within 3 tiles; adjacent enemies

Hostile creatures adjacent to the healed ally take 1d4 fire damage once from scattering embers.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Zealot's Renewal

cards.name: Undying Ember

cards.rangeAndTarget: Self; enemies adjacent to you; allies within 2 tiles
cards.duration: Instantaneous; enemy penalty until end of next turn
cards.effect: When damage would reduce you to 0 HP without killing you outright, remain at 1 HP. Up to three living allies within 2 tiles each regain 1d6 HP. This removes no Wounds and cannot trigger from self-inflicted staged damage.
cards.prerequisite: Oracle 6; Mystery: Flame; selected Tier II Revelation

value.name: Undying Ember

cards.name: First Flame Convergence
cards.effect: For 2 rounds, once on each of your turns when a Flame Revelation deals fire damage, add one extra die matching that Revelation's primary damage die to one damage roll. Once per turn when one of your Flame Revelations damages a meaningful hostile creature, one living ally within 4 tiles regains 1d6 HP. Allies within 4 tiles are immune to Frightened. Once per turn when this effect heals an ally, that ally reduces the first damage it takes before your next turn by 1. Zealot's Renewal deals no backlash while Convergence lasts.

value.name: First Flame Convergence
value.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, your fire Revelations deal +25% damage and allies within 4 tiles heal 1d6 when you burn an enemy — you emit warm light and allies are immune to fear; the Crown's memory kindles: once per turn when you heal via wrathful fire, one ally within 4 tiles gains +5% DR until start of your next turn, and Zealot's Renewal backlash is suppressed during the convergence.

cards.name: Founder's Memory
cards.effect: Gain advantage on History checks involving Tyrnathar, the Crown of First Flame and the Tenfold Cycles. Once per long rest after failing a saving throw against fire damage or Frightened, reroll that save and use the new result.

value.name: Founder's Memory
value.description: Advantage on History checks involving Tyrnathar and the Tenfold Cycles. Once per day, invoke the Crown's memory to reroll a failed save vs fire or fear.

Once per ally during the Bloom, when damage would reduce it to 0 HP without instant death, it remains at 1 HP instead. Allies in the zone have necrotic immunity for the 3 rounds. When the Bloom ends, petals create light obscurement in the zone until the start of your next turn. It removes no Wounds and does not resurrect.

value.description: Advantage on Stealth and Insight. Once per day, read the hidden fear in one creature's heart — learn their greatest dread (DM provides truthful answer).

completeCurrentEnvelope.authoringNotes: Provisional; notebook adversarial findings reconciled and source-preserving editorial review complete. Human balance testing remains.

completeCurrentEnvelope.protectedInterfaceOriginal: A successful weapon hit between spell casts clears Refrain and reduces the next spell's Dissonance gain by 1 (minimum 0), rewarding the Ranger's martial/primal cadence.
engine: Dexterity governs weapons; Wisdom governs primal technique DC/M. This draft uses the detailed book's d8 Hit Die; older runtime d10 remains preserved as a conflicting alternative. At 1 gain Track Target engine: Bonus Action mark one perceived enemy within 90 ft for 1 minute, no RP, one quarry at a time; new mark replaces old. Once/own turn a weapon hit against quarry adds S damage. Mark does not reveal creatures through total cover. Track Target selection is an upgrade, not a second unlock tax.

Weapon Synergy tracks last successful direct weapon hit on your own turns. Changing melee→ranged grants+1 to that ranged attack roll if it is your first attack of the turn; changing ranged→melee makes the hit apply Bleed 1d4 on target's next 2 turns. Once/turn synergy; Do Ts, copies, companions, forced attacks and misses do not advance it. At 5 ordinary Attack Action makes two attacks; techniques use only printed counts. You may draw/stow one weapon as normal object interaction; Dual Style later improves this.

Elemental Attunement is defensive; Elemental Imbue is the separate Pathfinder feature gated 6. Imbue Bonus Action 2 RP, one element for 3 of your turns; once/turn a weapon hit adds 1d4 of chosen element plus fire:Burn 1d4 next target turn, cold:Speed-10 ft until end next turn, poison:CON save or-1 attack rolls until end next turn. Nonstacking; Do Ts never build Hit Chain. Switching element pays again.

Druidic Arrow Combo starts at Ranger 11, not at Base 1. Each direct successful weapon hit adds 1 Hit Chain, maximum 2 gained per regular turn and cap 3. Completing 3 primes one Arrow until end next turn; using it consumes the chain, even on miss. Efficient Killer lowers threshold 2. Chain starts/ends encounters 0, cannot be stocked against allies/captives/summons and is cleared by incapacitation. The Arrow is one Action with a ranged weapon attack or the stated save, costs 0 RP when primed, and is a magical class technique rather than an ordinary spell cast. At most one Arrow per round; it cannot advance its own chain. It requires a wielded bow and ammunition. Ordinary attack/damage riders apply once as printed, never another free arrow.

All Rangers learn five bounded Arrows at 11. Emberroot requires the previous 3 successful weapon hits carried fire imbue: ranged attack, weapon+S d6 fire on hit; up to 2 others within 5 ft take S fire, and primary target Burns 1d4 next turn. Glacial Thorn requires 2 ranged+1 melee among those 3 hits: ranged attack weapon+S d6 cold; on hit STR save or Speed 0 until end next turn. Venomlash requires poisoned/blighted terrain at you or target: ranged attack weapon+S d6 poison; on hit CON save or-1 damage on its next attack. Spirit Fang requires quarry: ranged attack at advantage, weapon+S d6 force; ignores resistance but not immunity on the added force only. Cleansing Grove requires natural terrain at you or target: up to 3 living allies within 10 ft of a point within 60 ft each end Frightened or Poisoned; no attack or damage.

Chosen Hero grants a sixth Arrow at 11. Warder Nature's Wrath: ranged attack weapon+S d6 piercing; up to 2 allies within 10 ft gain M temporary HP (finite mitigation, not repeatable real healing). Stalker Phantom: two ranged attacks against different aligned targets within 60 ft, each weapon damage, no extra dice; one Arrow activation. Outrider Corruption: place 10 ft-radius zone within 60 ft, concentration until start next turn; up to 3 enemies entering/starting there take S d4 necrotic once each, CON half. Arrow copies cannot generate extra attacks, resources or permanent terrain changes.

A successful direct weapon hit between ordinary spell casts clears Refrain and gives the next ordinary spell before end next turn 1 less Dissonance, minimum 0. The benefit is single-use/nonstacking; it reduces neither RP nor both base and repeat separately. Ordinary spells use Ranger rank gates and the shared test magic configuration.

Base choices 1–2, Pathfinder Arch 3–9, and chosen Warder/Stalker/Outrider Hero 10–20 are distinct stages. No source Arch capstone/Finale exists: level 9 receives its normal eligible choice, while 20 automatically improves your Hero Arrow once/long rest (new capstone below). Do not acquire a Hero by spending Base choices. Beast Companion is one permanent bond; it must be a willing/tamed noncorrupted beast with INT<7 and CR no greater than your class level. Its combat profile uses the bounded companion below rather than importing a full CR 20 monster.

If a primed Arrow expires unused, the prime ends and Hit Chain resets to 0. This applies equally to Efficient Killer’s threshold of two. Efficient Killer itself requires Ranger 11, when Hit Chain exists.
workedExample: Ranger 11, DEX 18, WIS 16, PB 4, S 3, M 3, RP 18. Track quarry with Bonus Action; no RP spent. Start Hit Chain 0.
Turn 1 normal Attack Action has 2 attacks; both hit quarry, chain 0→2. Apply quarry bonus 3 once, not twice. No Arrow until next qualifying hit.

Turn 2 first weapon attack hits, chain 2→3 and primes Arrow. You already spent your Action on Attack, so cannot freely add an Arrow. An extra Action from an ally would use the shared cap, but none is assumed.
Turn 3 use Spirit Fang Arrow as Action, consume chain 3→0, pay 0 RP. On hit weapon+3d6 force; advantage does not double damage. The Arrow cannot rebuild its own chain.

Turn 4 cast an ordinary rank 1 spell after the previous direct weapon hit between casts. Pay 2 RP, RP 18→16 plus any pre-existing strain surcharge. Its base 1 D is reduced by 1 to 0; the one-use cadence benefit ends.
On encounter end unused chain and mark expire. RP does not refill. Natural-terrain healing and companions still need their printed finite costs.
balanceQuestions: Can switching weapons remain worthwhile without eclipsing focused styles?
Does the level11 Arrow timing feel rewarding without free attacks?
Are permanent companions useful while respecting a shared command budget?
